title: Integrate caliptra port with hw-model emulator
description: Wire up the wolfSSL Caliptra CryptoCb port to the Caliptra hw-model C binding so caliptra_test.c exercises real Caliptra firmware instead of the hand-rolled simulator. Pre-built artifacts exist in ~/caliptra/target/debug/ and ~/caliptra/hw-model/c-binding/out/. Architecture: caliptra_test -> caliptra_mailbox_exec (our hook) -> caliptra_mailbox_execute (libcaliptra) -> caliptra_if.h (write_u32/read_u32/wait) -> caliptra_model_apb_* (hw-model C binding) -> libcaliptra_hw_model_c_binding.a (Rust, pre-built).
